reason: Fresh first-party Electra Italy tariff documentation dated 2026-07-01 establishes a deterministic national direct tariff for Italy across slow and fast AC/DC charging, with explicit separation by direct payment channel. This supersedes the stale seed's unresolved ELC state and allows Electra Italia to be treated network-wide without station-level extrapolation.

changes.eligibility: public tariff; source notes prices shown do not include potential discounts
positiveEvidence: Electra's official tariff help page dated 2026-07-01 states that in Italy slow and fast AC/DC charging costs 0.69 EUR/kWh via the Electra app and 0.79 EUR/kWh by bank card at the terminal, VAT included.
The same page states these direct-price rules apply to sessions started through the Electra app, Autocharge, or bank-card terminal.
Electra's official variable-pricing page dated 2026-07-07 limits station/time-variable pricing to France, Belgium and Spain; Italy is not included in that variable-pricing exception.
The variable-pricing page separately describes Electra+ roaming/ChargeLeague economics, so those subscription/eMSP prices are not promoted as direct CPO tariffs.
negativeEvidence: Do not use Electra+ ChargeLeague Italy 0.64 EUR/kWh as the direct CPO tariff; it is a subscription/eMSP commercial condition.
Do not map third-party RFID prices to Electra direct tariffs because the official page warns that additional charges outside Electra's control may apply to RFID payments.
Do not import France/Belgium/Spain demand-based station pricing into Italy; the current official variable-pricing page names those countries, not Italy.
changes.resumeCondition: Reopen only if Electra changes the official Italy tariff table, introduces an Italy-specific station/time exception, or canonical inventory reveals non-Electra-owned ELC rows outside the stated direct-network scope.
